t: You're looking at The Young Lovers, an outdoor sculpture in Festival Gardens, installed in 1973. It's by Georg Ehrlich, an Austrian sculptor who moved to London in 1938 and became a British citizen in 1947. He lived from 1897 to 1966, so this piece was installed several years after his death. It's a quiet work in a garden setting, and a good place to pause and look at the figures.
